name: supSeminorm_le_supSpectralValue_of_eval₂_eq_zero
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_le_supSpectralValue_of_eval₂_eq_zero [HasSupSeminorm K A] (φ : B →ₐ[K] A)
    {q : B[X]} (hq : q.Monic) {f : A} (hf : q.eval₂ (φ : B →+* A) f = 0) :
    supSeminorm K f ≤ supSpectralValue K q
doc:
/-- BGR 6.2.2/3 (= 3.8.1/6 (b)): if `fⁿ + φ(b₁)fⁿ⁻¹ + ⋯ + φ(bₙ) = 0`, then
`|f|_sup ≤ max_i |b_i|_sup^{1/i} = σ(q)`. The proof is purely seminorm-theoretic (BGR p. 239):
`|f|ⁿ_sup = |fⁿ|_sup ≤ |φ(b_j) fⁿ⁻ʲ|_sup ≤ |b_j|_sup |f|_sup^{n−j}` for some `j`. -/

name: exists_comap_algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem exists_comap_algebraMap_eq [Algebra.IsIntegral B A] [FaithfulSMul B A]
    (y : MaximalSpectrum B) :
    ∃ x : MaximalSpectrum A, x.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap B A) = y.asIdeal
doc:
/-- Going up (BGR 3.8.1/6 (a), "there is a maximal ideal `x` of `A` lying over `y`"): for `A`
integral over `B` with injective structure map, every maximal ideal of `B` is the contraction of a
maximal ideal of `A`. -/

name: isMaximal_comap_algebraMap_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem isMaximal_comap_algebraMap_of_isIntegral [Algebra.IsIntegral B A] (x : MaximalSpectrum A) :
    (x.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap B A)).IsMaximal
doc: /-- The contraction of a maximal ideal of `A` along an integral map is maximal. -/

name: isAlgebraic_quotient_of_isAlgebraic_quotient_comap
statement:
theorem isAlgebraic_quotient_of_isAlgebraic_quotient_comap [Algebra.IsIntegral B A]
    (x : MaximalSpectrum A)
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K (B ⧸ x.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap B A))] :
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic K (A ⧸ x.asIdeal)
doc:
/-- For `A` integral over `B`, the residue field at `x` is algebraic over `K` as soon as the residue
field at `φ⁻¹(x)` is (BGR 3.8.1/6 (a): "`A/x` is integral over `B/y`. Therefore `A/x` is an
algebraic extension of `k`"). -/

name: HasSupSeminorm.of_isIntegral
statement: theorem HasSupSeminorm.of_isIntegral [HasSupSeminorm K B] : HasSupSeminorm K A
doc:
/-- BGR 3.8.1/6 (c), one direction: `|·|_sup` is finite on `A` if it is finite on `B`, because
`|f|_sup ≤ max |b_i|_sup^{1/i}` for any equation of integral dependence (3.8.1/6 (b)). -/

name: HasSupSeminorm.of_isIntegral_of_faithfulSMul
statement:
theorem HasSupSeminorm.of_isIntegral_of_faithfulSMul [HasSupSeminorm K A] [FaithfulSMul B A] :
    HasSupSeminorm K B
doc:
/-- BGR 3.8.1/6 (c), the other direction, for an injective structure map (every `y` has a point
`x` over it). -/

name: supSeminorm_algebraMap_eq
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_algebraMap_eq [HasSupSeminorm K A] [HasSupSeminorm K B] [FaithfulSMul B A]
    (b : B) : supSeminorm K (algebraMap B A b) = supSeminorm K b
doc: /-- BGR 3.8.1/6 (a): an integral monomorphism is an isometry for `|·|_sup`. -/

name: supSeminorm_le_of_forall_supSeminorm_mk_map_le
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_le_of_forall_supSeminorm_mk_map_le [HasSupSeminorm K A] {f : A} {C : ℝ}
    (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (h : ∀ y : MaximalSpectrum B,
      supSeminorm K (Ideal.Quotient.mk (y.asIdeal.map (algebraMap B A)) f) ≤ C) :
    supSeminorm K f ≤ C
doc:
/-- `|f|_sup` is the supremum over `y ∈ Max B` of `|f mod yA|_sup` (BGR p. 172,
"`|f|_sup = sup_{y ∈ Max_k B} |f_y|_sup`"), upper-bound half: every point of `A` lies over a point
of `B`. -/

name: exists_evalNorm_root_eq_supSpectralValue
statement:
theorem exists_evalNorm_root_eq_supSpectralValue {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] {q : L[X]} (hq : q.Monic) (hq0 : 0 < q.natDegree)
    [HasSupSeminorm K (AdjoinRoot q)] :
    ∃ x : MaximalSpectrum (AdjoinRoot q),
      evalNorm K x (AdjoinRoot.root q) = supSpectralValue K q
doc:
/-- **The fibre computation** (BGR p. 172, the display `|f̄_y|_sup = max_ν |f̄_ν|_ν = max_ν σ(q_ν)
= σ(q_y)`): over a field `L` algebraic over `K`, the class of `X` in `L[X] ⧸ (q)` for a monic `q`
of positive degree attains `σ(q)` at some maximal ideal. The maximal ideals of `L[X] ⧸ (q)` are the
monic irreducible factors `p` of `q`; at `p` the residue field is `L[X] ⧸ (p)` and `|X(p)|` is the
norm of a root of `p` in a splitting field of `q` (Mathlib `max_norm_root_eq_spectralValue`). -/

name: evalNorm_root_le_supSpectralValue
statement:
theorem evalNorm_root_le_supSpectralValue {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra K L]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] {q : L[X]} (hq : q.Monic) [HasSupSeminorm K (AdjoinRoot q)]
    (x : MaximalSpectrum (AdjoinRoot q)) :
    evalNorm K x (AdjoinRoot.root q) ≤ supSpectralValue K q
doc:
/-- The upper bound in the fibre: `|X(x)| ≤ σ(q)` at every point (a root of `q` in the residue
field has norm at most the spectral value, Mathlib `norm_root_le_spectralValue`). -/

name: supSeminorm_eq_spectralNorm
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_eq_spectralNorm {L : Type*} [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L]
    [HasSupSeminorm K L] (b : L) : supSeminorm K b = spectralNorm K L b
doc:
/-- Over a field `L` algebraic over `K`, the supremum seminorm is the spectral norm, so
`supSpectralValue` of a polynomial over `L` is its Mathlib `spectralValue` for the spectral norm.
Stated through the point evaluation at the unique maximal ideal `⊥`. -/

name: HasSupSeminorm.of_field
statement:
theorem HasSupSeminorm.of_field (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra K L] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L] :
    HasSupSeminorm K L
doc: /-- A field algebraic over `K` has a supremum seminorm (one point, the spectral norm). -/

name: supSpectralValue_minpoly_le_supSeminorm
statement:
theorem supSpectralValue_minpoly_le_supSeminorm (f : A) :
    supSpectralValue K (minpoly B f) ≤ supSeminorm K f
doc:
/-- The fibre of `B[f] ≅ B[X]/(q)` over `y ∈ Max B` is `(B ⧸ y)[X] ⧸ (q̄)` (BGR p. 172,
"`A/yA = (B/y)[X]/(q_y)`"); the sup seminorm of `f` on it is `σ(q̄)` by the fibre computation, so
`|f|_sup = sup_y σ(q_y) = max_i |b_i|_sup^{1/i}`. Lower-bound half of 3.8.1/7 (a). -/

name: supSeminorm_eq_supSpectralValue_minpoly
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_eq_supSpectralValue_minpoly (f : A) :
    supSeminorm K f = supSpectralValue K (minpoly B f)
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.1/7 (a)**: `|f|_sup = max_{1≤i≤n} |b_i|_sup^{1/i}` where
`fⁿ + b₁fⁿ⁻¹ + ⋯ + bₙ = 0` is the integral equation of minimal degree of `f` over `B`. -/

name: minpoly_algebraMap_mul_eq_scaleRoots
statement:
theorem minpoly_algebraMap_mul_eq_scaleRoots {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) (f : A) :
    minpoly B (algebraMap B A b * f) = (minpoly B f).scaleRoots b
doc:
/-- The minimal polynomial of `b • f` is the scaled minimal polynomial of `f` (BGR p. 173,
"`(bf)ⁿ + bb₁(bf)ⁿ⁻¹ + ⋯ + bⁿbₙ = 0` is the integral equation of minimal degree for any such
product `bf`"). -/

name: supSeminorm_algebraMap_mul
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_algebraMap_mul
    (hB : ∀ b b' : B, supSeminorm K (b * b') = supSeminorm K b * supSeminorm K b') (b : B) (f : A) :
    supSeminorm K (algebraMap B A b * f) = supSeminorm K b * supSeminorm K f
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.1/7 (d)**, the if direction: if `|·|_sup` is multiplicative on `B`, then
`|φ(b) f|_sup = |b|_sup |f|_sup`. -/

name: exists_evalNorm_eq_supSeminorm_of_forall_exists
statement:
theorem exists_evalNorm_eq_supSeminorm_of_forall_exists
    (hB : ∀ b : B, ∃ y : MaximalSpectrum B, evalNorm K y b = supSeminorm K b) (f : A) :
    ∃ x : MaximalSpectrum A, evalNorm K x f = supSeminorm K f
doc: /-- **BGR 3.8.1/7 (b)**: the maximum modulus principle transfers from `B` to `A`. -/

name: eq_zero_of_supSeminorm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_supSeminorm_eq_zero (hB : ∀ b : B, supSeminorm K b = 0 → b = 0) {f : A}
    (hf : supSeminorm K f = 0) : f = 0
doc: /-- **BGR 3.8.1/7 (c)**: if `|·|_sup` is a norm on `B` then it is a norm on the domain `A`. -/

name: supSeminorm_pow_factorial_mem_range_norm
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_pow_factorial_mem_range_norm
    (hB : ∀ b : B, supSeminorm K b ∈ Set.range (fun c : K ↦ ‖c‖)) {n : ℕ}
    (hn : ∀ f : A, (minpoly B f).natDegree ≤ n) (f : A) :
    supSeminorm K f ^ n.factorial ∈ Set.range (fun c : K ↦ ‖c‖)
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.1/8** in the form used by 6.2.1/4 (ii): if the values `|b|_sup`, `b ∈ B`, lie in
`‖K‖` (true for `T_d`, whose supremum norm is the Gauss norm), and the minimal polynomials over `B`
have degree at most `n`, then `|f|_sup ^ n.factorial ∈ ‖K‖` for every `f`: a uniform exponent. -/

name: AlgHom.continuous_of_supSeminorm_eq_zero_imp
statement:
theorem AlgHom.continuous_of_supSeminorm_eq_zero_imp
    [Affinoid.HasSupSeminorm K A]
    (hfin : ∀ x : MaximalSpectrum A, FiniteDimensional K (A ⧸ x.asIdeal))
    (hA : ∀ f : A, Affinoid.supSeminorm K f = 0 → f = 0) (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) : Continuous φ
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.2/3.** If `|·|_sup` is a norm on the Banach algebra `A` (with algebraic residue
fields), every `K`-algebra homomorphism from a Banach algebra `B` into `A` is continuous. Proof:
closed graph through the maximal ideals (`AlgHom.continuous_of_forall_isClosed_of_finiteDimensional`
with `𝔅 = {𝔪 | 𝔪.IsMaximal}`: maximal ideals of a Banach algebra are closed, their contractions
are maximal hence closed, the residue fields are finite over `K`, and `⋂ 𝔪 = 0` by 3.8.1/9). -/

name: MaximalSpectrum.isClosed_asIdeal
statement:
theorem MaximalSpectrum.isClosed_asIdeal (x : MaximalSpectrum A) :
    IsClosed (x.asIdeal : Set A)
doc:
/-- Maximal ideals of a Banach algebra are closed (Mathlib `Ideal.IsMaximal.isClosed`, stated for
the maximal spectrum). -/

name: AlgEquiv.exists_forall_norm_le_mul_of_supSeminorm_eq_zero_imp
statement:
theorem AlgEquiv.exists_forall_norm_le_mul_of_supSeminorm_eq_zero_imp [IsUltrametricDist B]
    [NormOneClass B] [Affinoid.HasSupSeminorm K A]
    (hfin : ∀ x : MaximalSpectrum A, FiniteDimensional K (A ⧸ x.asIdeal))
    (hA : ∀ f : A, Affinoid.supSeminorm K f = 0 → f = 0) (e : A ≃ₐ[K] B) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ a : A, ‖e a‖ ≤ C * ‖a‖
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.2/4.** All complete `K`-algebra norms on `A` are equivalent when `|·|_sup` is a norm:
for an algebra isomorphism `e : A ≃ B` between such Banach algebras there is `C` with
`‖e a‖ ≤ C * ‖a‖`. -/

name: supSeminorm_le_norm_pow_rpow
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_le_norm_pow_rpow [HasSupSeminorm K A] (f : A) (i : ℕ+) :
    supSeminorm K f ≤ ‖f ^ (i : ℕ)‖ ^ (1 / (i : ℝ))
doc: /-- `|f|_sup ≤ ‖fⁱ‖^{1/i}` for every `i ≥ 1`, by 3.8.2/2 and power-multiplicativity. -/

name: supSeminorm_le_smoothingFun
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_le_smoothingFun [HasSupSeminorm K A] (f : A) :
    supSeminorm K f ≤ smoothingFun (SeminormedRing.toRingSeminorm A) f
doc:
/-- `|f|_sup ≤ inf_i ‖fⁱ‖^{1/i}` (BGR 3.8.2/5, the first inequality: "From Corollary 2 one deduces
immediately that `|f|_sup ≤ |f|_r`"). -/

name: smoothingFun_le_of_eval₂_eq_zero
statement:
theorem smoothingFun_le_of_eval₂_eq_zero {B : Type*} [CommRing B] (φ : B →+* A) {q : B[X]}
    (hq : q.Monic) {f : A} (hf : q.eval₂ φ f = 0) :
    smoothingFun (SeminormedRing.toRingSeminorm A) f ≤
      ⨆ n : Fin q.natDegree, ‖φ (q.coeff n)‖ ^ (1 / (q.natDegree - n : ℝ))
doc:
/-- The smoothing seminorm bounds a root of a monic polynomial by the spectral value for the
seminorm `inf ‖·ⁱ‖^{1/i}` (BGR 3.8.2/5: "one can apply Proposition 3.1.2/1 … and one gets
`|f|_r ≤ max |φ(b_i)|_r^{1/i}`"), with the coefficients bounded by `‖φ(b_i)‖`. -/

name: supSeminorm_eq_smoothingFun_of_isIntegral
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.2/5**: under the hypotheses of 3.8.1/7, if `B → A` is continuous for `|·|_sup`
(`‖algebraMap b‖ ≤ C * |b|_sup`), then `|f|_sup = inf_i ‖fⁱ‖^{1/i}`. -/

name: isPowerBounded_of_supSeminorm_le_one_of_isIntegral
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.2/6 (c') ⇒ (a')**: under the hypotheses of 3.8.2/5, `|f|_sup ≤ 1` makes `f`
power-bounded (the powers of `f` lie in the bounded `B̊`-module `Σ_{i<n} φ(B̊) fⁱ`). -/

name: IsPowerBounded.supSeminorm_le_one
statement:
theorem IsPowerBounded.supSeminorm_le_one {f : A} (hf : IsPowerBounded f) :
    supSeminorm K f ≤ 1
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.2/6 (a') ⇒ (c')** needs no integrality: power-bounded implies `|f|_sup ≤ 1`, since
`|·|_sup ≤ ‖·‖` and `|·|_sup` is power-multiplicative. -/

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_supSeminorm_lt_one_of_isIntegral
doc: /-- **BGR 3.8.2/6 (a) ⇔ (c)**: topologically nilpotent iff `|f|_sup < 1`, under 3.8.2/5. -/

name: Submodule.forall_mem_of_forall_exists_eq_add_sum_smul_of_norm_lt_one
statement:
theorem Submodule.forall_mem_of_forall_exists_eq_add_sum_smul_of_norm_lt_one {n m : ℕ}
    (N : Submodule A (Fin n → A)) (x : Fin m → Fin n → A)
    (h : ∀ i, ∃ y ∈ N, ∃ c : Fin m → A, (∀ μ, ‖c μ‖ < 1) ∧ x i = y + ∑ μ, c μ • x μ) :
    ∀ i, x i ∈ N
doc:
/-- Nakayama for the unit ball in `Aⁿ` (the module form of
`Ideal.forall_mem_of_forall_exists_eq_add_sum_mul_of_norm_lt_one`): if finitely many vectors
`x i` of `Aⁿ` lie in `N + Σ 𝔞 x μ` with `𝔞` the open unit ball ideal, they lie in `N`. -/

name: Submodule.exists_forall_exists_eq_sum_smul_norm_le
statement:
theorem Submodule.exists_forall_exists_eq_sum_smul_norm_le {n m : ℕ} (x : Fin m → Fin n → A)
    (N : Submodule A (Fin n → A)) (hN : IsClosed (N : Set (Fin n → A)))
    (hx : Submodule.span A (Set.range x) = N) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ z ∈ N, ∃ a : Fin m → A, z = ∑ i, a i • x i ∧ ∀ i, ‖a i‖ ≤ C * ‖z‖
doc:
/-- Open mapping for a finitely generated closed submodule `N = span (range x)` of `Aⁿ`: every
`z ∈ N` is `Σ aᵢ • xᵢ` with `max ‖aᵢ‖ ≤ C ‖z‖` (the module form of
`Ideal.exists_forall_exists_eq_sum_mul_norm_le`). -/

name: Submodule.isClosed_of_isNoetherianRing_pi
statement:
theorem Submodule.isClosed_of_isNoetherianRing_pi {n : ℕ} (N : Submodule A (Fin n → A)) :
    IsClosed (N : Set (Fin n → A))
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.7.2/2 (module form)**: every submodule of `Aⁿ` over a noetherian Banach algebra is
closed. -/

name: Submodule.isClosed_of_isClosed_comap
statement:
theorem Submodule.isClosed_of_isClosed_comap {n : ℕ} (π : (Fin n → A) →ₗ[A] M)
    (hπ : Continuous π) (hs : Function.Surjective π) (N : Submodule A M)
    (hN : IsClosed ((N.comap π : Submodule A (Fin n → A)) : Set (Fin n → A))) :
    IsClosed (N : Set M)
doc:
/-- A continuous surjective `K`-linear map from the Banach space `Aⁿ` onto `M` is open, so a
submodule of `M` is closed as soon as its preimage in `Aⁿ` is. -/

name: Submodule.isClosed_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite
statement:
theorem Submodule.isClosed_of_isNoetherianRing_of_finite [Module.Finite A M] (N : Submodule A M) :
    IsClosed (N : Set M)
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.7.3/1**: every submodule of a complete finite normed module over a noetherian Banach
algebra is closed. -/

name: IsBanachFunctionAlgebra.eq_zero_of_supSeminorm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem IsBanachFunctionAlgebra.eq_zero_of_supSeminorm_eq_zero
    (hA : IsBanachFunctionAlgebra K A) {f : A} (hf : supSeminorm K f = 0) : f = 0
doc: /-- In a Banach function algebra `|·|_sup` is a norm: `|f|_sup = 0 → f = 0`. -/

name: IsBanachFunctionAlgebra.norm_eq_supSeminorm_of_isPowMul
statement:
theorem IsBanachFunctionAlgebra.norm_eq_supSeminorm_of_isPowMul [HasSupSeminorm K A]
    (hA : IsBanachFunctionAlgebra K A) (hpm : IsPowMul (fun f : A ↦ ‖f‖)) (f : A) :
    ‖f‖ = supSeminorm K f
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.3/3** (with 1.3.1/3): a power-multiplicative complete algebra norm on a Banach
function algebra is the supremum seminorm. -/

name: IsBanachFunctionAlgebra.of_isClosed_range
statement:
theorem IsBanachFunctionAlgebra.of_isClosed_range [HasSupSeminorm K A] [HasSupSeminorm K B]
    (hA : IsBanachFunctionAlgebra K A) (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Continuous φ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective φ) (hcl : IsClosed (Set.range φ)) : IsBanachFunctionAlgebra K B
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.3/4**: a Banach algebra `B` mapping continuously and injectively with closed range
into a Banach function algebra `A` is a Banach function algebra (open mapping onto the closed range,
then the contraction `|φ b|_sup ≤ |b|_sup`). -/

name: IsBanachFunctionAlgebra.of_finite_injective
statement:
theorem IsBanachFunctionAlgebra.of_finite_injective [HasSupSeminorm K A] [HasSupSeminorm K B]
    [IsNoetherianRing B] (hA : IsBanachFunctionAlgebra K A) (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : Continuous φ)
    (hinj : Function.Injective φ) (hfin : φ.toRingHom.Finite) : IsBanachFunctionAlgebra K B
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.3/5**: for `φ : B → A` finite, injective and continuous with `B` noetherian and `A` a
Banach function algebra, `B` is a Banach function algebra (`φ(B)` is closed in the finite normed
`B`-module `A` by 3.7.3/1). -/

name: Module.isTorsionFree_of_faithfulSMul_of_isDomain
statement: theorem Module.isTorsionFree_of_faithfulSMul_of_isDomain : Module.IsTorsionFree B A
doc: /-- A domain finite over `B` with injective structure map is torsion-free over `B`. -/

name: exists_basis_universalDenominator
statement:
theorem exists_basis_universalDenominator :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (a : Fin n → A) (b : B), b ≠ 0 ∧
      LinearIndependent B a ∧ ∀ f : A, ∃ β : Fin n → B, b • f = ∑ i, β i • a i
doc:
/-- The coordinates of `A` inside `Q(A) = Q(B)ⁿ`: `Q(A)` is finite-dimensional over `Q(B)` (Layer 1
`FractionRing.finiteDimensional_of_finite`) with a basis `a₁, …, aₙ` of elements of `A`, and there
is a universal denominator `b ≠ 0` in `B` with `b • A ⊆ Σ B aᵢ` (BGR p. 181, "there is a universal
denominator `b ∈ B − {0}` such that `A ⊂ A' := Σ B aᵢ/b`"). -/

name: exists_coordinateMap
statement:
theorem exists_coordinateMap {n : ℕ} {a : Fin n → A} {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0)
    (ha : LinearIndependent B a) (hA : ∀ f : A, ∃ β : Fin n → B, b • f = ∑ i, β i • a i) :
    ∃ θ : A →ₗ[B] (Fin n → B), Function.Injective θ ∧
      (∀ f, b • f = ∑ i, θ f i • a i) ∧ IsClosed (Set.range θ)
doc:
/-- The coordinate map `θ : A → Bⁿ`, `f ↦ β` with `b • f = Σ βᵢ • aᵢ`, is `B`-linear, injective,
and has closed range in `Bⁿ` (BGR 3.7.2/2, `Submodule.isClosed_of_isNoetherianRing_pi`). -/

name: exists_norm_le_mul_norm_coordinateMap
statement:
theorem exists_norm_le_mul_norm_coordinateMap (hcont : Continuous (algebraMap B A)) {n : ℕ}
    {a : Fin n → A} {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) (θ : A →ₗ[B] (Fin n → B)) (hθ : Function.Injective θ)
    (hθa : ∀ f, b • f = ∑ i, θ f i • a i) (hcl : IsClosed (Set.range θ)) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : A, ‖f‖ ≤ C * ‖θ f‖

name: spectralNorm_fractionRing_eq_supSeminorm
statement:
theorem spectralNorm_fractionRing_eq_supSeminorm (hBsup : ∀ b : B, supSeminorm K b = ‖b‖)
    [HasSupSeminorm K A] [Algebra (FractionRing B) (FractionRing A)]
    [IsScalarTower B (FractionRing B) (FractionRing A)] (f : A) :
    letI := IsFractionRing.normedField B (FractionRing B)
    spectralNorm (FractionRing B) (FractionRing A) (algebraMap A (FractionRing A) f) =
      supSeminorm K f
doc:
/-- **The spectral norm of `Q(A)` over `Q(B)` restricts to `|·|_sup` on `A`** (BGR 3.8.3/7, "From
Proposition 3.8.1/7 (a), we derive `|f|_sup = |f|_sp`"; the Remark after 3.8.1/9): when
`|·|_sup = ‖·‖` on `B`, the spectral norm of `f ∈ A ⊆ Q(A)` for the absolute value of `Q(B)`
extending `‖·‖` equals `supSeminorm K f`. -/

name: exists_norm_coordinateMap_le_mul_supSeminorm
statement:
theorem exists_norm_coordinateMap_le_mul_supSeminorm (hBsup : ∀ b : B, supSeminorm K b = ‖b‖)
    (hws : letI := IsFractionRing.normedField B (FractionRing B); IsWeaklyStable (FractionRing B))
    [HasSupSeminorm K A] {n : ℕ} {a : Fin n → A} {b : B} (hb : b ≠ 0) (ha : LinearIndependent B a)
    (θ : A →ₗ[B] (Fin n → B)) (hθa : ∀ f, b • f = ∑ i, θ f i • a i) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : A, ‖θ f‖ ≤ C * supSeminorm K f
doc:
/-- Weak stability bounds the coordinates by the spectral norm: `‖θ f i‖ ≤ C * |f|_sup`
(BGR 3.8.3/7, "Since `Q(B)` is weakly stable, all these extensions are weakly `Q(B)`-cartesian
under their spectral norm"). -/

name: IsBanachFunctionAlgebra.of_finite_domain
statement:
theorem IsBanachFunctionAlgebra.of_finite_domain (hBsup : ∀ b : B, supSeminorm K b = ‖b‖)
    (hws : letI := IsFractionRing.normedField B (FractionRing B); IsWeaklyStable (FractionRing B))
    (hcont : Continuous (algebraMap B A)) : IsBanachFunctionAlgebra K A
doc:
/-- **BGR 3.8.3/7** (for `A` a domain, plan D1): `A` finite over `B` with injective continuous
structure map, `B` a valued (`NormMulClass`) integrally closed noetherian Banach function algebra
(`|·|_sup = ‖·‖`) with weakly stable fraction field, then `A` is a Banach function algebra:
`‖f‖ ≤ C * |f|_sup`. -/

name: hasSupSeminorm
statement: theorem hasSupSeminorm (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) : HasSupSeminorm K A
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.1/1.** An affinoid algebra has a supremum seminorm: the residue fields are finite
over `K` (Corollary 6.1.2/3, Layer 1) and `|f(x)| ≤ ‖g‖` for any preimage `g ∈ Tₙ` of `f`
(Corollary 3.8.2/2 through the presentation). -/

name: supSeminorm_le_norm_of_eq
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_le_norm_of_eq {n : ℕ} (α : TateAlgebra K n →ₐ[K] A) {g : TateAlgebra K n}
    {f : A} (hg : α g = f) : supSeminorm K f ≤ ‖g‖
doc:
/-- Through a presentation `α : Tₙ ↠ A`, `|f|_sup ≤ ‖g‖` for every preimage `g` of `f`
(BGR p. 236, "`|f|_sup ≤ |f|_α for all f ∈ A and all epimorphisms α: Tₙ → A`"). -/

name: exists_evalNorm_eq_supSeminorm_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem exists_evalNorm_eq_supSeminorm_of_isDomain (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) [IsDomain A]
    (f : A) : ∃ x : MaximalSpectrum A, evalNorm K x f = supSeminorm K f
doc:
/-- **The maximum modulus principle for affinoid domains** (BGR 6.2.1/4 (i), the special case):
Noether normalisation `T_d ↪ A` (finite, injective), `T_d` integrally closed with the maximum
modulus principle (Layer 0), and BGR 3.8.1/7 (b). -/

name: exists_evalNorm_eq_supSeminorm
statement:
theorem exists_evalNorm_eq_supSeminorm (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) [Nontrivial A] (f : A) :
    ∃ x : MaximalSpectrum A, evalNorm K x f = supSeminorm K f
doc:
/-- **The maximum modulus principle** (BGR 6.2.1/4 (i); Bosch 1.4/14): for a nonzero affinoid
algebra `A` and `f ∈ A` there is a point `x` with `|f(x)| = |f|_sup`. Through the minimal primes
(BGR 6.2.1/3) from the domain case. -/

name: exists_forall_pow_supSeminorm_mem_range_norm_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem exists_forall_pow_supSeminorm_mem_range_norm_of_isDomain (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    [IsDomain A] :
    ∃ m : ℕ, m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ f : A, supSeminorm K f ^ m ∈ Set.range (fun c : K ↦ ‖c‖)
doc:
/-- The values of `|·|_sup` on an affinoid domain have a power in `‖K‖`, with a uniform exponent:
`|f|_sup ^ n! ∈ ‖K‖` where `n = [Q(A) : Q(T_d)]` bounds the degrees of the minimal polynomials over
`T_d` (BGR 3.8.1/8 with `|T_d|_sup = |K|`). -/

name: exists_forall_exists_smul_pow_supSeminorm_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_forall_exists_smul_pow_supSeminorm_eq_one (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) :
    ∃ m : ℕ, m ≠ 0 ∧ ∀ f : A, supSeminorm K f ≠ 0 → ∃ c : K, supSeminorm K (c • f ^ m) = 1
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.1/4 (ii), uniform form** (roadmap §2.2.2): there is `m ≥ 1` depending only on `A`
such that every `f` with `|f|_sup ≠ 0` has `c ∈ K` with `|c f^m|_sup = 1`. -/

name: exists_smul_pow_supSeminorm_eq_one
statement:
theorem exists_smul_pow_supSeminorm_eq_one (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) {f : A}
    (hf : supSeminorm K f ≠ 0) : ∃ (c : K) (m : ℕ), m ≠ 0 ∧ supSeminorm K (c • f ^ m) = 1
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.1/4 (ii)** (Bosch 1.4/15): for `|f|_sup ≠ 0` there are `c ∈ K` and `m ≥ 1` with
`|c f^m|_sup = 1`. -/

name: supSeminorm_eq_zero_iff_isNilpotent
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_eq_zero_iff_isNilpotent (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) (f : A) :
    supSeminorm K f = 0 ↔ IsNilpotent f
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.1/4 (iii)**: `|f|_sup = 0` iff `f` is nilpotent (the Jacobson radical of an affinoid
algebra is its nilradical, Layer 1 `isJacobsonRing`, with BGR 3.8.1/9). -/

name: eq_zero_of_supSeminorm_eq_zero
statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_supSeminorm_eq_zero (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) [IsReduced A] {f : A}
    (hf : supSeminorm K f = 0) : f = 0
doc: /-- **BGR 6.2.1/4 (iii)**, second half: on a reduced affinoid algebra `|·|_sup` is a norm. -/

name: isReduced_of_forall_supSeminorm_eq_zero_imp
statement:
theorem isReduced_of_forall_supSeminorm_eq_zero_imp (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (h : ∀ f : A, supSeminorm K f = 0 → f = 0) : IsReduced A
doc:
/-- The converse: if `|·|_sup` is a norm then `A` is reduced (a ring with a power-multiplicative
norm is reduced, BGR 1.3.1). -/

name: _root_.AlgHom.continuous_of_isReduced_of_isAffinoidAlgebra
statement:
theorem _root_.AlgHom.continuous_of_isReduced_of_isAffinoidAlgebra (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    [IsReduced A] (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) : Continuous φ
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.1/5**: every `K`-algebra homomorphism from a (not necessarily noetherian) Banach
algebra into a reduced affinoid Banach algebra is continuous (BGR 3.8.2/3 + 6.2.1/4 (iii)). -/

name: supSeminorm_map_eq_of_isIntegral
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_map_eq_of_isIntegral (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B)
    (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) (hint : φ.toRingHom.IsIntegral) (hinj : Function.Injective φ) (b : B) :
    supSeminorm K (φ b) = supSeminorm K b
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.2/1**, second half: an integral monomorphism of affinoid algebras is an isometry for
`|·|_sup` (BGR 3.8.1/6 (a)). The first half, "every homomorphism is a contraction", is
`Affinoid.supSeminorm_map_le`. -/

name: supSeminorm_eq_supSpectralValue_minpoly_tateAlgebra
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_eq_supSpectralValue_minpoly_tateAlgebra (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    [IsDomain A] [Algebra.IsIntegral (TateAlgebra K d) A] [FaithfulSMul (TateAlgebra K d) A]
    (f : A) : supSeminorm K f = supSpectralValue K (minpoly (TateAlgebra K d) f)
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.2/2**, the equation `|f|_sup = max |tᵢ|^{1/i}` for an affinoid domain `A` integral
over `T_d` with injective structure map (BGR 3.8.1/7 (a) with `T_d` integrally closed and
`|·|_sup = ‖·‖` on `T_d`). -/

name: supSeminorm_algebraMap_tateAlgebra_mul
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_algebraMap_tateAlgebra_mul (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) [IsDomain A]
    [Algebra.IsIntegral (TateAlgebra K d) A] [FaithfulSMul (TateAlgebra K d) A]
    (t : TateAlgebra K d) (f : A) :
    supSeminorm K (algebraMap (TateAlgebra K d) A t * f) = ‖t‖ * supSeminorm K f
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.2/2**, `|·|_sup` is a faithful `T_d`-algebra norm: `|φ(t) f|_sup = |t| |f|_sup`
(BGR 3.8.1/7 (d), the Gauss norm being multiplicative). -/

name: exists_monic_eval₂_eq_zero_supSeminorm_eq_supSpectralValue_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem exists_monic_eval₂_eq_zero_supSeminorm_eq_supSpectralValue_of_isDomain
    (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) [IsDomain A] (φ : B →ₐ[K] A)
    (hfin : φ.toRingHom.Finite) (f : A) :
    ∃ q : B[X], q.Monic ∧ q.eval₂ (φ : B →+* A) f = 0 ∧ supSeminorm K f = supSpectralValue K q
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.2/4** for an affinoid domain `A`: for `φ : B → A` finite (plan D10) there is a monic
`q ∈ B[X]` with `q(f) = 0` and `|f|_sup = σ(q)` (compose with `ψ : T_d → B` from Theorem
6.1.2/1 so that `φ ∘ ψ` is an integral monomorphism, take the minimal polynomial over `T_d` and
push its coefficients into `B`; `σ(q) ≤ σ(p)` by contraction, `≥` by 6.2.2/3). -/

name: exists_monic_eval₂_eq_zero_supSeminorm_eq_supSpectralValue
statement:
theorem exists_monic_eval₂_eq_zero_supSeminorm_eq_supSpectralValue (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) [Nontrivial A] (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) (hfin : φ.toRingHom.Finite)
    (f : A) :
    ∃ q : B[X], q.Monic ∧ q.eval₂ (φ : B →+* A) f = 0 ∧ supSeminorm K f = supSpectralValue K q
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.2/4** (Bosch 1.4/13): for `φ : B → A` finite (plan D10) between affinoid algebras and
`f ∈ A` there is a monic `q ∈ B[X]` with `q(f) = 0` and `|f|_sup = σ(q)`. From the domain case
through the minimal primes: `q := (∏ qᵢ)^e` with `qᵢ(f) ∈ 𝔭ᵢ` and `e` killing the nilradical, then
BGR 1.5.4/1 and 6.2.1/3. -/

name: powerBounded
statement: noncomputable def powerBounded : Subring A where
doc:
/-- `Å = {f | |f|_sup ≤ 1}`, the power-bounded elements of an affinoid algebra (BGR 6.2.3/1,
1.2.5/2): a subring by BGR 3.8.1/3. -/

name: topologicallyNilpotent
statement: noncomputable def topologicallyNilpotent : Ideal (powerBounded K A) where
doc:
/-- `Ǎ = {f | |f|_sup < 1}`, the topologically nilpotent elements, an ideal of `Å`
(BGR 6.2.3/2, 1.2.5/2). -/

name: topologicallyNilpotent_isRadical
statement: theorem topologicallyNilpotent_isRadical : (topologicallyNilpotent K A).IsRadical
doc: /-- `Ǎ` is a radical ideal of `Å` (BGR 1.2.5/7: `Ã = Å/Ǎ` is reduced), by power-multiplicativity. -/

name: algebraMap_mem_powerBounded
statement:
theorem algebraMap_mem_powerBounded {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ 1) :
    algebraMap K A c ∈ powerBounded K A
doc: /-- The scalars of absolute value `≤ 1` are power-bounded. -/

name: isPowerBounded_iff_supSeminorm_le_one
statement:
theorem isPowerBounded_iff_supSeminorm_le_one (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) (f : A) :
    IsPowerBounded f ↔ supSeminorm K f ≤ 1
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.3/1** (Bosch 1.4/16): `f` is power-bounded iff `|f|_sup ≤ 1`. "⇒" is 3.8.2/2 with
power-multiplicativity; "⇐": choose a finite `φ : T_d → A`, an integral equation with
`|f|_sup = max |tᵢ|^{1/i}` (6.2.2/4), so `tᵢ ∈ T̊_d`, and `f^{n+ν} ∈ Σ_{i<n} φ(T̊_d) fⁱ` by
induction, a bounded set since `φ(T̊_d)` is bounded (`φ` continuous, Layer 1). -/

name: isPowerBounded_iff_mem_powerBounded
statement:
theorem isPowerBounded_iff_mem_powerBounded (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) (f : A) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm
    IsPowerBounded f ↔ f ∈ powerBounded K A
doc: /-- The subring `Å` is the set of power-bounded elements for every complete algebra norm. -/

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_supSeminorm_lt_one
statement:
theorem isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_supSeminorm_lt_one (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) (f : A) :
    IsTopologicallyNilpotent f ↔ supSeminorm K f < 1
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.3/2 (i) ⇔ (iii)** (Bosch 1.4/17): `f` is topologically nilpotent iff `|f|_sup < 1`.
"⇒" by 3.8.2/2 and power-multiplicativity; "⇐" by 6.2.1/4 (ii): `|c f^m|_sup ≤ 1` for some
`|c| > 1`, so `c f^m` is power-bounded and `f^m ∈ c⁻¹ Å ⊆ Ǎ`. -/

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_forall_evalNorm_lt_one
statement:
theorem isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_forall_evalNorm_lt_one (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    [Nontrivial A] (f : A) :
    IsTopologicallyNilpotent f ↔ ∀ x : MaximalSpectrum A, evalNorm K x f < 1
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.3/2 (i) ⇔ (ii)**: `f` is topologically nilpotent iff `|f(x)| < 1` at every point
(the maximum modulus principle). -/

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_mem_topologicallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem isTopologicallyNilpotent_iff_mem_topologicallyNilpotent (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (f : A) (hf : supSeminorm K f ≤ 1) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm
    IsTopologicallyNilpotent f ↔ (⟨f, hf⟩ : powerBounded K A) ∈ topologicallyNilpotent K A

name: supSeminorm_eq_smoothingFun
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_eq_smoothingFun (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) (f : A) :
    supSeminorm K f = smoothingFun (SeminormedRing.toRingSeminorm A) f
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.3/3** (the spectral radius formula): `|f|_sup = inf_i ‖fⁱ‖^{1/i}` for every complete
`K`-algebra norm on `A`. "≤" is 3.8.2/2; "≥": if `|f|_sup < |f|'` then by 6.2.1/4 (ii) one may
assume `|f|_sup = 1 < |f|'`, so `‖fⁱ‖ ≥ |f|'^i → ∞` and `f` is not power-bounded, contradicting
6.2.3/1. -/

name: lipschitzWith_supSeminorm
statement:
theorem lipschitzWith_supSeminorm (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) :
    LipschitzWith 1 (supSeminorm K : A → ℝ)
doc:
/-- `|·|_sup` is `1`-Lipschitz for any complete algebra norm: `|f|_sup ≤ ‖f‖` and the
ultrametric inequality, so `|f|_sup - |g|_sup ≤ ‖f - g‖`. -/

name: isClosed_powerBounded
statement:
theorem isClosed_powerBounded (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm
    IsClosed (powerBounded K A : Set A)

name: isOpen_powerBounded
statement:
theorem isOpen_powerBounded (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm
    IsOpen (powerBounded K A : Set A)
doc: /-- `Å` is open: it contains the open unit ball of the norm and is an additive subgroup (§2.4.3). -/

name: isOpen_setOf_supSeminorm_lt_one
statement:
theorem isOpen_setOf_supSeminorm_lt_one (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) :
    IsOpen {f : A | supSeminorm K f < 1}

name: exists_norm_le_mul_supSeminorm_iff_isBounded_powerBounded
statement:
theorem exists_norm_le_mul_supSeminorm_iff_isBounded_powerBounded (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm
    (∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : A, ‖f‖ ≤ C * supSeminorm K f) ↔
      TopologicalRing.IsBounded (powerBounded K A : Set A)
doc:
/-- **Uniformity, norm form** (§2.3.5): `Å` is bounded in `A` iff `|·|_sup` is equivalent to the
norm of `A`. "⇐" is clear; "⇒" (BGR p. 181, end of the proof of 3.8.3/6): for `|f|_sup ≠ 0` pick
`c ∈ K`, `|c| > 1`, and `m` with `|c|^{m−1} < |f|_sup ≤ |c|^m`; then `c^{−m} f ∈ Å` is bounded by
`M`, so `‖f‖ ≤ M |c|^m ≤ M |c| |f|_sup`; for `|f|_sup = 0`, `c^{-m} f ∈ Å` for all `m` forces
`f = 0`. -/

name: isReduced_of_isBounded_powerBounded
statement:
theorem isReduced_of_isBounded_powerBounded (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (h : haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm; TopologicalRing.IsBounded (powerBounded K A : Set A)) :
    IsReduced A
doc:
/-- If `Å` is bounded then `A` is reduced (a nonzero nilpotent `f` has `c^{-m} f ∈ Å` for every
`m`). -/

name: powerBounded.ofUnitClosedBall
statement: noncomputable def powerBounded.ofUnitClosedBall : unitClosedBall K →+* powerBounded K A where
doc: /-- The unit ball of `K` maps into `Å` (`|c · 1|_sup ≤ ‖c‖ ≤ 1`). -/

name: powerBounded.ofUnitClosedBall_mem_topologicallyNilpotent
doc:
/-- The maximal ideal of the unit ball of `K` maps into `Ǎ`, so `Ã` is a `K̃`-algebra
(BGR 6.2.3/4: "`Ã = Å/Ǎ` … is a `k̃`-algebra"). -/

name: Reduction.ofResidueField
statement: noncomputable def Reduction.ofResidueField : ResidueField (unitClosedBall K) →+* Reduction K A
doc: /-- The reduction map `K̃ → Ã`. -/

name: Reduction.isReduced
statement: instance Reduction.isReduced : IsReduced (Reduction K A)
doc: /-- **BGR 1.2.5/7**: `Ã` is reduced (`Ǎ` is a radical ideal of `Å`). -/

name: TateAlgebra.powerBounded_eq_unitClosedBall
statement:
theorem TateAlgebra.powerBounded_eq_unitClosedBall :
    powerBounded K (TateAlgebra K n) = unitClosedBall (TateAlgebra K n)
doc: /-- For the Tate algebra `Å` is the unit ball of the Gauss norm (`|·|_sup = ‖·‖`, Layer 0). -/

name: TateAlgebra.reductionEquiv
statement:
noncomputable def TateAlgebra.reductionEquiv :
    Reduction K (TateAlgebra K n) ≃+* MvPolynomial (Fin n) (ResidueField (unitClosedBall K))
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.3/4 for `Tₙ`** (roadmap §2.3.4): `T̃ₙ ≅ K̃[X₁, …, Xₙ]`, from Layer 0's
`MvPowerSeries.Restricted.reductionEquiv`. -/

name: supSeminorm_mul_of_isReduced_of_isDomain_reduction
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_mul_of_isReduced_of_isDomain_reduction (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    [IsReduced A] (hdom : haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm; IsDomain (Reduction K A)) (f g : A) :
    supSeminorm K (f * g) = supSeminorm K f * supSeminorm K g

name: isReduced_of_isValuation
statement:
theorem isReduced_of_isValuation (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (hnorm : ∀ f : A, supSeminorm K f = 0 → f = 0) : IsReduced A
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.3/5, "only if" (reducedness)**: if `|·|_sup` is a valuation (multiplicative and a
norm) then `A` is reduced (BGR 1.5.1: a valued ring is a domain; here 3.8.1/9 suffices). -/

name: isDomain_reduction_of_isValuation
statement:
theorem isDomain_reduction_of_isValuation (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) [Nontrivial A]
    (hmul : ∀ f g : A, supSeminorm K (f * g) = supSeminorm K f * supSeminorm K g)
    (hnorm : ∀ f : A, supSeminorm K f = 0 → f = 0) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm
    IsDomain (Reduction K A)
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.3/5, "only if" (the domain)**: if `|·|_sup` is a valuation then `Ã` is a domain
(BGR 1.5.1: "The ideal `Ǎ` is prime in `Å`; hence `Ã` is also an integral domain"). -/

name: isBanachFunctionAlgebra_of_isDomain
statement:
theorem isBanachFunctionAlgebra_of_isDomain [CharZero K] (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    [IsDomain A] : IsBanachFunctionAlgebra K A
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.4/1 for an affinoid domain** (`[CharZero K]`, plan D2): choose a finite
normalisation `φ : T_d ↪ A`; `φ` is continuous (Layer 1), `T_d` is a valued integrally closed
noetherian Banach function algebra (`|·|_sup = ‖·‖`, Layer 0) with weakly stable fraction field
(Layer 0, `isWeaklyStable_fractionRing`), so BGR 3.8.3/7 applies. -/

name: continuousSMul_pi_quotient
statement:
theorem continuousSMul_pi_quotient (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) :
    haveI : ∀ i, IsClosed ((𝔭 i : Ideal A) : Set A) := fun i ↦ hA.isClosed_ideal (𝔭 i)
    ContinuousSMul A (∀ i, A ⧸ 𝔭 i)
doc:
/-- The product `∏ A ⧸ 𝔭ᵢ` with the residue norms is a finite `A`-module with continuous scalar
multiplication (each quotient by a closed ideal, Layer 1 `isClosed_ideal`). -/

name: isClosed_range_pi_quotient_mk
statement:
theorem isClosed_range_pi_quotient_mk (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) :
    haveI : ∀ i, IsClosed ((𝔭 i : Ideal A) : Set A) := fun i ↦ hA.isClosed_ideal (𝔭 i)
    IsClosed (Set.range (RingHom.pi fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (𝔭 i)))
doc:
/-- The diagonal map `A → ∏ A ⧸ 𝔭ᵢ` is injective when `⋂ 𝔭ᵢ = ⊥`, continuous, and has closed range
(BGR 3.7.3/1: `A` is a submodule of the finite `A`-module `A'`). -/

name: exists_norm_le_mul_norm_pi_quotient_mk
statement:
theorem exists_norm_le_mul_norm_pi_quotient_mk (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (h : ⨅ i, 𝔭 i = ⊥) :
    haveI : ∀ i, IsClosed ((𝔭 i : Ideal A) : Set A) := fun i ↦ hA.isClosed_ideal (𝔭 i)
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : A, ‖f‖ ≤ C * ‖(RingHom.pi fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk (𝔭 i)) f‖
doc: /-- Open mapping for the diagonal map: `‖f‖ ≤ C * max_i ‖f mod 𝔭ᵢ‖` when `⋂ 𝔭ᵢ = ⊥`. -/

name: isBanachFunctionAlgebra_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem isBanachFunctionAlgebra_of_isReduced [CharZero K] (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    [IsReduced A] : IsBanachFunctionAlgebra K A
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.2.4/1** (M4; `[CharZero K]`, plan D2): every reduced affinoid algebra is a Banach
function algebra, i.e. `‖f‖ ≤ C * |f|_sup` for every complete `K`-algebra norm. Through the
diagonal map into `∏ A ⧸ 𝔭ᵢ` (minimal primes, `⋂ 𝔭ᵢ = nilradical = ⊥`), the domain case on each
factor, 6.2.1/3 (`|f mod 𝔭ᵢ|_sup ≤ |f|_sup`) and the open mapping bound. -/

name: isBounded_powerBounded_of_isReduced
statement:
theorem isBounded_powerBounded_of_isReduced [CharZero K] (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    [IsReduced A] :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm
    TopologicalRing.IsBounded (powerBounded K A : Set A)
doc: /-- **§2.3.5**: a reduced affinoid algebra has bounded `Å` (is "uniform" in the norm sense). -/

name: exists_norm_map_le_mul_supSeminorm
statement:
theorem exists_norm_map_le_mul_supSeminorm [CharZero K] (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A) [IsReduced A]
    {B : Type*} [NormedCommRing B] [NormedAlgebra K B] (φ : A →ₐ[K] B) (hφ : Continuous φ) :
    ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ f : A, ‖φ f‖ ≤ C * supSeminorm K f
doc:
/-- **§2.4.3**: on a reduced affinoid algebra every continuous algebra homomorphism into a Banach
algebra is bounded for `|·|_sup` (`‖φ f‖ ≤ C * |f|_sup`), the form in which the Banach function
algebra property is used downstream. -/

name: powerBoundedMap
statement: noncomputable def powerBoundedMap (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) : powerBounded K B →+* powerBounded K A where
doc:
/-- `φ̊ : B̊ → Å` (BGR 6.3: "each such `φ` maps power-bounded elements into power-bounded
elements", by the contraction 3.8.1/4). -/

name: powerBoundedMap_mem_topologicallyNilpotent
statement:
theorem powerBoundedMap_mem_topologicallyNilpotent (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) {b : powerBounded K B}
    (hb : b ∈ topologicallyNilpotent K B) : powerBoundedMap φ b ∈ topologicallyNilpotent K A
doc: /-- `φ̊` maps `B̌` into `Ǎ`. -/

name: reductionMap
statement: noncomputable def reductionMap (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) : Reduction K B →+* Reduction K A
doc: /-- `φ̃ : B̃ → Ã` (BGR 6.3, the commutative diagram). -/

name: reductionMap_mk
statement:
theorem reductionMap_mk (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) (b : powerBounded K B) :
    reductionMap φ (Reduction.mk K B b) = Reduction.mk K A (powerBoundedMap φ b)

name: reductionMap_id
statement: theorem reductionMap_id : reductionMap (AlgHom.id K A) = RingHom.id (Reduction K A)

name: reductionMap_comp
statement:
theorem reductionMap_comp (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) (ψ : C →ₐ[K] B) :
    reductionMap (φ.comp ψ) = (reductionMap φ).comp (reductionMap ψ)

name: reductionAlgHom
statement:
noncomputable def reductionAlgHom (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) :
    Reduction K B →ₐ[IsLocalRing.ResidueField (Subring.unitClosedBall K)] Reduction K A where
doc: /-- `φ̃` is `K̃`-linear. -/

name: isometry_iff_forall_supSeminorm_eq_one_imp
statement:
theorem isometry_iff_forall_supSeminorm_eq_one_imp (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) :
    (∀ g : B, supSeminorm K (φ g) = supSeminorm K g) ↔
      ∀ g : B, supSeminorm K g = 1 → supSeminorm K (φ g) = 1
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.3.1/1**: `φ` is an isometry for `|·|_sup` iff `|φ(f)|_sup = 1` whenever `|f|_sup = 1`
(scale by 6.2.1/4 (ii): `|c g^m|_sup = 1`, then `|c| |φ(g)|^m = 1 = |c| |g|^m`). -/

name: injective_reductionMap_iff_isometry
statement:
theorem injective_reductionMap_iff_isometry (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm; haveI := hB.hasSupSeminorm
    Function.Injective (reductionMap φ) ↔ ∀ g : B, supSeminorm K (φ g) = supSeminorm K g
doc: /-- **BGR 6.3.1/2**: `φ̃` is injective iff `φ` is an isometry for `|·|_sup`. -/

name: ker_le_nilradical_of_injective_reductionMap
statement:
theorem ker_le_nilradical_of_injective_reductionMap (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) (φ : B →ₐ[K] A)
    (h : haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm; haveI := hB.hasSupSeminorm
      Function.Injective (reductionMap φ)) :
    RingHom.ker φ ≤ nilradical B
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.3.1/3**: if `φ̃` is injective then `ker φ ⊆ rad B` (an isometry has kernel inside
`{|g|_sup = 0} = rad B`, 6.2.1/4 (iii)). -/

name: injective_of_isometry
statement:
theorem injective_of_isometry (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) [IsReduced B] (φ : B →ₐ[K] A)
    (h : ∀ g : B, supSeminorm K (φ g) = supSeminorm K g) : Function.Injective φ
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.3.1/6 (ii) ⇒ (i), injectivity**: for `B` reduced, an isometry for `|·|_sup` is
injective (`|·|_sup` is a norm on `B`, 6.2.1/4 (iii)). -/

name: comap_ker_reductionMap_eq_radical_of_isStrictMap
statement:
theorem comap_ker_reductionMap_eq_radical_of_isStrictMap (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : IsStrictMap φ) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm; haveI := hB.hasSupSeminorm
    (RingHom.ker (reductionMap φ)).comap (Reduction.mk K B) =
      (topologicallyNilpotent K B ⊔ RingHom.ker (powerBoundedMap φ)).radical
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.3.1/4, first equation**: for `φ` strict,
`τ⁻¹(ker φ̃) = rad (B̌ + ker φ̊)` in `B̊` (if `φ(g)ⁿ → 0` and `φ(B̌)` is open in `φ(B)` then
`φ(g)ⁿ ∈ φ(B̌)` for large `n`, i.e. `gⁿ ∈ B̌ + ker φ̊`). -/

name: ker_reductionMap_eq_radical_map_of_isStrictMap
statement:
theorem ker_reductionMap_eq_radical_map_of_isStrictMap (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : IsStrictMap φ) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm; haveI := hB.hasSupSeminorm
    RingHom.ker (reductionMap φ) =
      ((RingHom.ker (powerBoundedMap φ)).map (Reduction.mk K B)).radical
doc: /-- **BGR 6.3.1/4, second equation**: for `φ` strict, `ker φ̃ = rad (τ(ker φ̊))`. -/

name: injective_reductionMap_of_isStrictMap_of_ker_le_nilradical
statement:
theorem injective_reductionMap_of_isStrictMap_of_ker_le_nilradical (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) (hφ : IsStrictMap φ)
    (hker : RingHom.ker φ ≤ nilradical B) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm; haveI := hB.hasSupSeminorm
    Function.Injective (reductionMap φ)
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.3.1/5**: if `φ` is strict and `ker φ ⊆ rad B` then `φ̃` is injective (`B̌` is a radical
ideal, so `rad (B̌ + ker φ̊) = B̌`). -/

name: injective_reductionMap_of_injective_of_isStrictMap
statement:
theorem injective_reductionMap_of_injective_of_isStrictMap (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) (φ : B →ₐ[K] A) (hinj : Function.Injective φ)
    (hφ : IsStrictMap φ) :
    haveI := hA.hasSupSeminorm; haveI := hB.hasSupSeminorm
    Function.Injective (reductionMap φ)
doc: /-- **BGR 6.3.1/6 (i) ⇒ (iii)**: an injective strict `φ` has injective `φ̃` (no reducedness). -/

name: isStrictMap_of_isometry
statement:
theorem isStrictMap_of_isometry [CharZero K] (hA : IsAffinoidAlgebra K A)
    (hB : IsAffinoidAlgebra K B) [IsReduced B] (φ : B →ₐ[K] A)
    (h : ∀ g : B, supSeminorm K (φ g) = supSeminorm K g) : IsStrictMap φ
doc:
/-- **BGR 6.3.1/6 (ii) ⇒ (i), strictness** (M5; `[CharZero K]`, plan D2): for `B` reduced an
isometry `φ` for `|·|_sup` is strict: `‖g‖_B ≤ C |g|_sup = C |φ(g)|_sup ≤ C ‖φ(g)‖_A` by
6.2.4/1 on `B`, and `φ` is continuous (6.1.3/1), so `φ` is a homeomorphism onto its image. -/

name: supSeminorm_X
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_X (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    supSeminorm K (Restricted.X K (1 : Fin n → ℝ) i) = 1

name: supSeminorm_natCast
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_natCast (n m : ℕ) :
    supSeminorm K (m : TateAlgebra K n) = ‖(m : K)‖
doc: /-- `|m|_sup = ‖m‖` in `Tₙ`; over `ℚ_p` this is `|p|_sup = p⁻¹`. -/

name: isPowerBounded_X
statement:
theorem isPowerBounded_X (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) :
    IsPowerBounded (Restricted.X K (1 : Fin n → ℝ) i)
doc: /-- `X` is power-bounded in `K⟨X⟩` (`|X|_sup = 1`). -/

name: isTopologicallyNilpotent_smul_X
statement:
theorem isTopologicallyNilpotent_smul_X (n : ℕ) (i : Fin n) {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ < 1) :
    IsTopologicallyNilpotent (c • Restricted.X K (1 : Fin n → ℝ) i)
doc: /-- `c • X` is topologically nilpotent in `K⟨X⟩` for `‖c‖ < 1`. -/

name: supSeminorm_mk_X_span_X_sub_C
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_mk_X_span_X_sub_C {a : K} (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ 1) :
    supSeminorm K (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {X₁ K - Restricted.C (1 : Fin 1 → ℝ) a}) (X₁ K)) =
      ‖a‖
doc: /-- `|X|_sup = ‖a‖` in `K⟨X⟩/(X − a)` for `‖a‖ ≤ 1` (the single point `X = a`). -/

name: supSeminorm_mk_X_span_X_sq
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_mk_X_span_X_sq :
    supSeminorm K (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {X₁ K ^ 2}) (X₁ K)) = 0
doc: /-- The nilpotent `ε = X` in `K⟨X⟩/(X²)` has `|ε|_sup = 0`. -/

name: norm_mk_X_span_X_sq
statement: theorem norm_mk_X_span_X_sq : ‖Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {X₁ K ^ 2}) (X₁ K)‖ = 1
doc:
/-- The nilpotent `ε = X` in `K⟨X⟩/(X²)` has residue norm `1` (every `X + g X²` has Gauss norm
`≥ 1`). -/

name: not_isBounded_powerBounded_span_X_sq
statement:
theorem not_isBounded_powerBounded_span_X_sq :
    haveI := (IsAffinoidAlgebra.tateAlgebra_quotient 1 (Ideal.span {X₁ K ^ 2})).hasSupSeminorm
    ¬ TopologicalRing.IsBounded
      (powerBounded K (T₁ ⧸ Ideal.span {X₁ K ^ 2}) : Set (T₁ ⧸ Ideal.span {X₁ K ^ 2}))
doc:
/-- `K⟨X⟩/(X²)` is not uniform: its power-bounded elements are unbounded (it is not reduced,
`isReduced_of_isBounded_powerBounded`). -/

name: supSeminorm_mk_X_span_X_sq_sub_C
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_mk_X_span_X_sq_sub_C {a : K} (ha : ‖a‖ ≤ 1) :
    supSeminorm K
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {X₁ K ^ 2 - Restricted.C (1 : Fin 1 → ℝ) a}) (X₁ K)) =
      ‖a‖ ^ (1 / 2 : ℝ)
doc:
/-- `|X|_sup = ‖a‖^{1/2}` in `K⟨X⟩/(X² − a)` for `‖a‖ ≤ 1` (the roots of `X² − a` have spectral
norm `‖a‖^{1/2}`); over `ℚ_p` with `a = p` this is `p^{−1/2} ∉ |ℚ_p^×|`. -/

name: supSeminorm_mk_X_annulus
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_mk_X_annulus {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ 1) :
    supSeminorm K (Ideal.Quotient.mk (annulusIdeal c) (Restricted.X K (1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) 0)) = 1
doc: /-- `|f₁|_sup = 1` in `K⟨X, Y⟩/(XY − c)` for `‖c‖ ≤ 1` (the point `x₁ = (X − 1, Y − c)`). -/

name: supSeminorm_mk_Y_annulus
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_mk_Y_annulus {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ 1) :
    supSeminorm K (Ideal.Quotient.mk (annulusIdeal c) (Restricted.X K (1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) 1)) = 1
doc: /-- `|f₂|_sup = 1` in `K⟨X, Y⟩/(XY − c)` for `‖c‖ ≤ 1` (the point `x₂ = (X − c, Y − 1)`). -/

name: supSeminorm_mk_X_mul_Y_annulus
statement:
theorem supSeminorm_mk_X_mul_Y_annulus {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ 1) :
    supSeminorm K (Ideal.Quotient.mk (annulusIdeal c)
      (Restricted.X K (1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) 0 * Restricted.X K (1 : Fin 2 → ℝ) 1)) = ‖c‖
doc: /-- `|f₁ f₂|_sup = |c|_sup = ‖c‖` in `K⟨X, Y⟩/(XY − c)` (BGR p. 242). -/

name: not_forall_supSeminorm_mul_annulus
statement:
theorem not_forall_supSeminorm_mul_annulus {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ < 1) :
    ¬ ∀ f g : T₂ ⧸ annulusIdeal c,
      supSeminorm K (f * g) = supSeminorm K f * supSeminorm K g
doc:
/-- **The supremum seminorm need not be multiplicative** (BGR 6.2.3, the example after 6.2.3/5):
on `K⟨X, Y⟩/(XY − c)` with `‖c‖ < 1` it is not. -/

name: isAffinoidAlgebra_prod
statement: theorem isAffinoidAlgebra_prod : IsAffinoidAlgebra K (K × K)
doc: /-- `K × K` with the maximum norm is an affinoid algebra (a quotient of `T₁`). -/

name: prodHom
statement: noncomputable def prodHom {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ 1) : TateAlgebra K 1 →ₐ[K] K × K

name: prodHom_X
statement:
theorem prodHom_X {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ 1) :
    prodHom K hc (Restricted.X K (1 : Fin 1 → ℝ) 0) = (c, 0)

name: surjective_prodHom
statement:
theorem surjective_prodHom {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ ≤ 1) (hc0 : c ≠ 0) :
    Function.Surjective (prodHom K hc)
doc:
/-- `φ` is surjective ("It is easily verified that `φ` is surjective": `(1, 0)` and `(0, 1)` are
`φ(X / c)`-free: `φ(c⁻¹X) = (1, 0)`, `φ(1 − c⁻¹X) = (0, 1)` for `c ≠ 0`). -/

name: not_surjective_reductionMap_prodHom
statement:
theorem not_surjective_reductionMap_prodHom {c : K} (hc : ‖c‖ < 1) :
    haveI := (isAffinoidAlgebra_prod K).hasSupSeminorm
    ¬ Function.Surjective (reductionMap (prodHom K hc.le))
doc:
/-- `φ̃ : K̃[X] → K̃ × K̃` is not surjective for `‖c‖ < 1`, since `|φ(X)|_sup = ‖c‖ < 1` forces
`φ̃(X) = 0`, so the image of `φ̃` is the image of `K̃`, the diagonal. -/

name: isAffinoidAlgebra_of_finiteDimensional
statement: theorem isAffinoidAlgebra_of_finiteDimensional : IsAffinoidAlgebra K L
doc: /-- A finite extension of `K` is an affinoid `K`-algebra. -/

name: injective_reductionMap_ofId
statement:
theorem injective_reductionMap_ofId :
    haveI := (isAffinoidAlgebra_of_finiteDimensional K L).hasSupSeminorm
    Function.Injective (reductionMap (Algebra.ofId K L))
doc:
/-- BGR 6.3.1 Example 1, the injectivity: `K̃ → L̃` is injective (`K ↪ L` is an isometry for the
spectral norm, 6.3.1/2). -/

name: not_surjective_algebraMap_of_one_lt_finrank
statement:
theorem not_surjective_algebraMap_of_one_lt_finrank (h : 1 < Module.finrank K L) :
    ¬ Function.Surjective (algebraMap K L)
doc:
/-- BGR 6.3.1 Example 1, the non-surjectivity: `K → L` is not surjective when `[L : K] > 1`.
(The existence of such `L` with `K̃ → L̃` bijective, e.g. `ℚ₂(√2)/ℚ₂`, is plan D5.) -/
